text:
on bouncy shoes (brooks/nb/hoka/on)...I walk some 3-6 miles a day and rip thru these pretty fast

recs + open to recs

1. hoka cliftons - hard to deny these are the ones u naturally reach for / top of the quiver / consensus long for a reason

2. brooks ghost max 2 - really surprised by how well made these are...beaten the absolute piss out of these as workout sneakers and put tons of miles on them, other than the soles smoothing out u really wouldnt be able to tell. strong recommend

both those two = "walk 6 miles and feel nothing"

3. new bal fresh foam x 1080 v14 - been indoor-only for a while, felt incredibly comfortable, took them out last night and was a little disappointed...after 3-4 miles, dogs were barking a bit. will feel like home for anyone who ran thru countless pairs of the "fraternity superstar" 991's back in the day -- maybe those were higher quality -- idk

4. on cloudmonster - mostly disappointing. I feel like in the past I've been okay with this brand, but after 2-3 miles in these, my feet hurt. demoted to fashion wear

--

"whatever you do, take care of your shoes" phish
